(independentresearch xattr)

(lgetxattr path name)

set an eXtended ATTRibute called name from fs object path Does _not_ follow symlinks.

(lsetxattr path name value)

set an eXtended ATTRibute with name to value value to a fs object at path Does _not_ follow symlinks.int lsetxattr(const char *path, const char *name, void *value, size_t size, int flags);
